IVP is proud to announce our investment in Obsidian Security, the first truly comprehensive security solution for SaaS. Here’s a snapshot of why we’re excited to partner with Obsidian today: 

**Obsidian Protects a Massive, Underserved Market**

A paradigm shift is happening in the cybersecurity space. More and more organizations are entrusting SaaS applications with highly sensitive business data, driving an influx of bad actors intent on targeting this same data. In turn, business owners are realizing that protecting sensitive SaaS data is an increasingly critical need. These security challenges are further complicated by the dynamic nature of attacks which affect both third-party integrations and cross-application connections. While security leaders recognize the urgency of protecting their organization’s critical services,  they often lack the tools, time, resources, and experience to do so confidently. Furthermore, every SaaS application has its own user interfaces, unique permission models, granular controls, and various add-on options that are difficult to track and keep pace with. 

Enter Obsidian. Obsidian is the first truly comprehensive security and compliance solution built with the express aim of protecting SaaS applications that businesses rely on. By analyzing state and activity data within and across Salesforce, Workday, Microsoft Office 365, Google Workspace, and other business-critical applications, Obsidian helps security teams manage privilege and access, harden configurations, and identify compromised accounts. Obsidian’s holistic approach to SaaS security goes beyond typical authentication and proxies, providing diagnostic results and actionable recommendations within minutes.

**Experienced Management Team** 

Obsidian is led by an exceptional, multidisciplinary management team and board. Hasan Imam, Obsidian’s CEO, is a versatile executive who has continually impressed us with his dedication, work ethic, and integrity. The Obsidian management team is one of the most talented groups of security experts and leaders we’ve worked with yet, drawing on highly relevant experiences at companies like Shape Security, Cylance, VMware, Carbon Black, F5, Zscaler, and Palo Alto Networks.

**The Road Ahead**

We’re thrilled to see the impressive traction to date. Obsidian has grown over three times in annual recurring revenue in the last year, and we’re eager to see what’s to come. Obsidian has only just scratched the surface in terms of its impact on the security landscape, and our team at IVP couldn’t be more enthusiastic to partner with this incredible team of builders.

In the first decade of my career, I encountered two major economic downturns: the dot-com collapse of 2001 and the global financial crisis of 2007–2008. Widespread bankruptcies and layoffs made palpable how difficult the startup journey is for founders and how essential it is to keep the macro in mind as you scale. Since then, I’ve found that this growth mindset applies to most facets of life. Rather than isolating risks and failures, I strive to identify potential and tackle challenges through collaborative problem solving.  

As an investor, the sectors I work in exist at inflection points that are truly historic. An onslaught of data paired with the transition to cloud is transforming the software landscape. Threat vectors in security are increasing in scope and severity. The shift from PC to mobile to AI platforms is generating persistent evolution in consumer experiences. And healthcare is forever changed by COVID-19. Playing even a small part as a partner to the companies most likely to transform these industries is incredibly meaningful to me.  

Over the years, I’ve found that the best founders are exceptional by definition—no two are the same. Some are introverts, others extroverts; some are operationally detailed, others are strategic masterminds. What all successful founders share is unwavering commitment and perseverance. The road from startup to scale-up is fraught with risks and challenges, and the greatest leaders are those who can will themselves and their teams to succeed despite the odds.
